```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
crime <- read_csv("crime_table.csv") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(field_1 %in% c(
    "Inner Harbor/Federal Hill",
    "South Baltimore",
    "Downtown/Seton Hill",
    "Poppleton/The Terraces/Hollins Market",
    "Pigtown/Carroll Park",
    "Fells Point"
  ))
```
